verdict.rationale: Windmill documents its own developer platform: scripts in many languages or any Docker image, workflows-as-code, the `wmill` CLI with Git-based deployment, and a published OpenAPI spec with a hosted reference. These let a developer build private integration logic in code. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated mechanism for packaging a reusable custom connector, such as defining custom resource or credential types, so connector-building is only implied. Missing for 10: documented custom connector or resource-type authoring, an official SDK for building integrations, and independent hands-on corroboration of building a private integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI
